name: pixel-farm-tools
description: Headless test / capture tools for pixel-farm (run from the repo root: npm --prefix tools ci)

scripts.check: node --check ../game.js && node --check ../wood.js && node --check ../sim.js && node --check ../save.js && node --check ../world.js && node --check ../kids.js && node --check ../family.js && node --check ../animals.js && node --check ../ui.js && node --check ../assets/palette.js && node --check ../assets/sprites.js && for f in *.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
